title: Empirical Bayesian Multi-Bandit Learning
abstract: arXiv:2510.26284v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multi-task learning in contextual bandits has attracted significant research interest due to its potential to enhance decision-making across multiple related tasks by leveraging shared structures and task-specific heterogeneity. In this article, we propose a novel hierarchical Bayesian framework for learning in various bandit instances. This framework captures both the heterogeneity and the correlations among different bandit instances through a hierarchical Bayesian model, enabling effective information sharing while accommodating instance-specific variations. Unlike previous methods that overlook the learning of the covariance structure across bandits, we introduce an empirical Bayesian approach to estimate the covariance matrix of the prior distribution. translated_title: 经验贝叶斯多老虎机学习
translated_abstract: 多任务情境老虎机学习因其在多个相关任务中利用共享结构和任务特定异质性来提升决策能力的潜力，引起了广泛的研究兴趣。在本文中，我们提出了一个新颖的分层贝叶斯框架，用于在各种老虎机实例中进行学习。该框架通过分层贝叶斯模型捕捉不同老虎机实例之间的异质性和相关性，在实现有效信息共享的同时兼顾实例特定的差异。与以往忽视跨老虎机协方差结构学习的方法不同，我们引入了一种经验贝叶斯方法来估计先验分布的协方差矩阵，从而提升了跨多老虎机学习的实用性与灵活性。基于该方法，我们开发了两种高效算法：ebmTS（经验贝叶斯多老虎机……）
tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的分层贝叶斯多老虎机学习框架，通过经验贝叶斯方法估计先验分布的协方差矩阵来捕捉老虎机实例间的相关性与异质性，并据此开发了ebmTS等高效算法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel hierarchical Bayesian framework for multi-bandit learning that employs an empirical Bayesian approach to estimate the prior covariance matrix, capturing correlations and heterogeneity across bandit instances, and develops efficient algorithms such as ebmTS.
